issues.description: Problem statement for Aufgabe 05 requests the average (durchschnittliche) area per Landkreis, but the solution implementation uses COUNT(flaeche) instead of AVG(flaeche), producing a count rather than the requested average. This contradicts the task requirement and would confuse students about the expected aggregation.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution to compute the average area using AVG(flaeche) and include the Landkreis name and Regierungsbezirk as requested. For example: SELECT kreis, regierungsbezirk, AVG(flaeche) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY kreis, regierungsbezirk ORDER BY kreis. Alternatively, if the intended metric was a count, update the problem statement to ask for a count instead of an average.
